title: Crayon
description: White crayon capitals on deep blue paper with painted paper oranges, after a hand-lettered photo on herb's board. Type and every letter is drawn stroke by stroke in waxy crayon that catches the paper's tooth; the lettering boils at eight frames a second, and the oranges can be picked up and moved.
intent: Hand-lettering as a material: a single-stroke skeleton alphabet drawn with a crayon that only deposits on the paper's peaks, slightly different every time, boiling on a stepped frame rate like hand-drawn animation.
sources: herb reference board: 7463 white crayon capitals on blue paper with oranges
